# ui/vendor

Libraries the chat window uses, copied from npm so the dashboard never loads code from the internet.

| File | Library | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| marked.umd.js | marked (Markdown) | 18.0.12 | MIT |
| purify.min.js | DOMPurify (HTML sanitizer) | 3.4.15 | Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0 |
| highlight.min.js, hljs-*.min.js | highlight.js (code colors) | 11.12.0 | BSD-3-Clause |
| katex/ | KaTeX (math) | 0.18.7 | MIT |
| chart.umd.min.js | Chart.js (charts) | 4.5.1 | MIT |
| mermaid.min.js | Mermaid (diagrams) | 12.0.0 | MIT |

License texts are in licenses/.
